title: Time evolution of quantum gates and the necessity of complex numbers
summary: As physical systems, qubits must evolve from input to output state. We describe a simple scheme in which the effect of a quantum gate is described by the action of an effective Hamiltonian acting for some characteristic time. This model shows that the action of common unary gates is to induce Bloch sphere trajectories along lines of latitude relative to an eigenvector of the gate. Such trajectories would immediately move a `rebit', initially confined to a line of latitude, off this line and acquire a complex phase.
